query:
SELECT rm.room_id, rm.membership,
                   COALESCE(r.name, '') AS "name!",
                   COALESCE(r.avatar_url, '') AS "avatar_url!"
            FROM room_memberships rm
            LEFT JOIN rooms r ON rm.room_id = r.room_id
            WHERE rm.user_id = $1
            ORDER BY rm.updated_ts DESC
